author: claude
title: Custom terrain 28 m limit at South Africa: Maps import and existing map

supersedes.why: 2026-11-04 runs stopped on test errors: a 'Do you really want to exit?' dialog left open (start block now leaves it), the API site lookup at step 57 (removed; a 10 min pause before Use existing map instead), and the planner's Import file tap, which cannot be tapped (removed; known not to work). Parts added (2026-11-05 rule).

requirement.text:
Android
Offline - Download a flight plan offline with custom terrain imported and make sure the custom terrain is still used when going offline

Test with terrain from various latitudes and make sure we have the same resolution constraint everywhere. e.g. ( create new sites for all of them )
Alaska
Antarctica
South Africa
Spain

source.locator: New test description, W-20261105-001 (latitudes: South Africa; your answer: both ways)

expected: At South Africa (-33.900000, 18.400000), in a new QA_ site: both synthetic UTM DSMs import as maps and process (status MAP). In a new flight there, Add terrain / map > Use existing map lists both; QA_<run>-28 (SouthAfrica_33.9S_28m_UTM.tif, app measures about 28 m) is selectable and QA_<run>-29 (SouthAfrica_33.9S_29m_UTM.tif, about 29 m) is listed but greyed out. Nothing in the planner is saved.

steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const row = n => { const el = [...d.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === n); let r = el; for (let i = 0; i < 5 && r; i++) { r = r.parentElement; const c = r && r.querySelector('input[type=checkbox], [role=checkbox], button'); if (c) return {found: true, disabled: !!(c.disabled || c.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || c.hasAttribute('data-disabled') || (c.closest('[aria-disabled=true]')))}; } return {found: !!el, disabled: null}; }; return {m28: row('QA_{run}-28'), m29: row('QA_{run}-29')}; })()

assert.expr: v['existing']['m28']['found'] and v['existing']['m28']['disabled'] is False and v['existing']['m29']['found'] and v['existing']['m29']['disabled'] is True
